description: Dark blue floor-length tailored overdress over ivory linen shift, low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and gold geometric woven borders along neckline, cuffs, bodice seams and front skirt edges. Paired round shoulder brooches, patterned belt with round buckle and hanging tasselled end, grey-beige fringed shoulder wrap laid around forearms, small pendant and earrings, brown leather shoes visible below hem. Both hands in front. No headgear, armor or weapon.
